items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 73:1
items.html: It is known that the lights, which are the records that remained from the levels that emerged in the world of Nekudim, did not descend together with the vessels to BYA when they broke, but rather departed from the vessels and remained in Atzilut. These lights are the secret of the Names. And the phase of the sparks that descended with the vessels to BYA are the phase of the fillings of the Names, for they are the phase of the coarse light of the records, containing within them the phase of coarseness called MAN, with which the upper light couples at the time of their ascent to Atzilut. They are called the fillings of the Names because, at the time of their ascent and their joining to the Names — that is, to their records — the upper light couples with them and draws out the level of the ten Sefirot belonging to the Names, that is, to the records, according to the level that had been in those records before the breaking of the vessels. And thus you find that the entire standing of the records, which are the Names, depends only on the filling, which is the sparks, for before the ascent of the sparks the Names are in the utmost smallness, since they have no coupling with the upper light except at the time of the ascent of the sparks in the secret of MAN, at which time the Names regain the level they had before the breaking. Understand this well.
